provenance: known-limit reproduction: derived from the code; reproduces the state-audit variable-resolution FN (dev state/05) in a DIFFERENT shape (reassigned let key + a renamed plain value binding). An initial draft left the value named 'bearer' and the tool caught it on the value-name heuristic — corrected so BOTH key and value are generic, faithfully reproducing the limit (documented honestly rather than left as a mis-built case).
source_of_truth: app/composables/useSession.ts persists a login token to localStorage. The key k is a local string reassigned to 'app:v2:k' and the value v is a plain binding of resp.data.v; neither identifier in setItem(k, v) contains a secret word, so a non-dataflow scan sees no signal. A correct dataflow-aware auditor should report token-in-web-storage at the setItem line.

expected.rationale: a login bearer token persisted to localStorage (XSS-readable); a real credential-in-web-storage defect visible only by resolving the key/value bindings.
